title: The dynamics in health-related quality of life of patients with stable coronary artery disease were revealed: a network analysis
limitations: - Networks are exploratory, not confirmatory; - Centrality measures may not be fully interpretable; - Item selection may lead to less informative network structures; - Patient-level networks are not generalizable; - Time lags assumption may affect results; - Multilevel VAR assumes all individuals' parameters originate from the same distribution.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available, but specific links or repositories are not provided in the text. The authors note that the network approach is still under development.
